MetaData.name: HelldiversRim
MetaData.author: chenxinjiu & friends
MetaData.description: A RimWorld x Helldivers content mod (pure XML + C#). Super-Earth consumables plus a one-shot auto mortar sentry dropped in via the stratagem beacon; it carries internal ammo and self-destructs into scrap when spent. Includes a gated Combat Extended ammo-compatibility patch and defs designed to be safe with performance/RimThreaded and UI/research mods.
